        - strong:

        - paragraph: R(x) = distance from axis to outer curve

        - paragraph: "[a,b] = interval of the region"
      - article:
        - heading "ONE WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Rotate the region between y=3√x and y=0 about the x-axis on [0,9].
        - text: R(x)=3√x, r(x)=0
        - paragraph: V=∫₀⁹π[(3√x)²−0²]dx
        - paragraph: =∫₀⁹9πx dx = 729π/2
        - strong: ≈ 1145.111 units³
      - article:
        - heading "⚠ COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=3]
        - text: Do not square the functions first!
        - paragraph: "Wrong: V=π∫[R(x)−r(x)]²dx"
        - paragraph: This computes a disc of radius (R−r), not a washer.
        - paragraph: "Correct: V=π∫[R(x)²−r(x)²]dx"
